module: Lifecycle callbacks of the UI routes for grid selector screens. On route entry or mount, it computes a snapshot (ui_gridSelector.getSelectorSnapshot) from the route's `meta.gridSelector` config and adds it to `data.gridSelector` (and `data.vehicleSelector` for the vehicleSelector backend). It also relays the onPauseEnter/onPauseMount/onPauseLeave hooks to `ui_pause_routeLifecycleCallbacks` when the route is a pause route.
notes: Per-route config: `route.meta.gridSelector = { backendName, routePath, defaultPath }`. Built-in default only for `pause.vehicleSelector` (backend vehicleSelector, routePath /vehicle-selector-pause, path { keys = { "allModels" } }).
The path comes from `toRoute.params` (path, keys or pathMatch as a table or an "a/b/c" string), otherwise from the default path.
Without a valid config, a warning is logged and no snapshot is attached.
A route is a pause route if its name is `pause`, starts with `pause.` or with `menu.pause`.
onRouteLeave does not attach a snapshot: it only relays onPauseLeave.

onRouteEnter.desc: Called by the UI router when entering a route. Relays onPauseEnter if it is a pause route, then attaches the selector snapshot to `data`.

data.desc: Route data table, enriched with gridSelector.

onRouteMount.desc: Called by the UI router when the route is mounted. Relays onPauseMount if it is a pause route, then attaches the selector snapshot to `data`.

onRouteLeave.desc: Called by the UI router when leaving a route. Only relays onPauseLeave for pause routes.
